messages:
Harper: tiny idea for the holidays  "Shelfie Sparkle Trade". bring one small desk trinket or photo of a decorative nook and swap anonymously. low-effort, low-cost. :sparkles: :package:
Lin: love this. remote folk can send photos or a tiny flat thing (sticker, postcard) to avoid shipping heavy items. :postcard:
Noor: count me in. optional clue note allowed so people can guess who their gifter is. also reactions for vibe: react to this message with :1st_place_medal: cozy, :clown_face: silly, :sparkling_heart: nostalgic.
Caleb: i'll handle in-office logistics. simple signup + dropoff table. i'll also make a tiny badge for each package so we can keep allergies/notes visible.
gift-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Shelfie Sparkle Trade" Fri 4:00 PM PT  RSVP by Thu 5PM.
Harper: signup (quick): https://tinyurl.com/rw-shelfie-trade (name + in-office/remote + ship ok? + public reveal yes/no).
Lin: dropoff details for in-office folks:
```
Drop table: mezzanine bookshelf
Drop window: Fri 9am-2pm
Label: "shelfie-sparkle" + recipient code (provided after sign-up)
```
Noor: shipping tip for remote: use lightweight padded envelopes, include a tiny clue card if you want to stay anonymous. US ship deadline Wed EOD. i'll DM international folks w/ local options.
Caleb: prize idea: a tiny mismatched-tinsel trophy for the most creative shelfie. i'll bring craft supplies. :trophy: :tinsel:
Harper: please choose sticker-only if you have food allergies. keep treats labeled.
Lin: montage plan: if you opt in we'll post a collage in #random Sat morning. consent checkbox on signup.
Noor: i voted :sparkling_heart:. excited to see everyone's tiny corners and silly knickknacks!
Caleb: i'll post final RSVP count Thu morning and assign recipient codes. thanks all  tiny holiday cheer incoming. :sparkler:
